description: Windkraft (Potenzial) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. As part of the "Energy Atlas Baden-Württemberg", the "Technical Wind Energy Potential" was determined for Baden-Württemberg. To calculate the wind potential, the areas within Baden-Württemberg that are generally eligible for the production of wind energy were first determined on the basis of a list of criteria. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wind power (potential)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include oac: 538, Klima, Energie. The listing shows 2019-05-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
